title: How to Run Your First AI Engineering Project
hookStatement: Building an AI feature is easy. Running an AI Engineering project is a completely different discipline.
industryTension: Most beginners start by picking a model. Senior engineers start by building an eval harness.
architecturalFramework: The 6-Part Production Guardrail: Test Suite, Schema Lock, Complexity Ladder, Budgets, Tracing, Fallbacks.
goldenRule: Never use an autonomous agent when deterministic code and a single structured prompt solves the problem.
takeawayAndCta: AI Engineering is not prompt engineering. It is software engineering applied to non-deterministic systems. Visit yvnalvworks.com/projects.
evidenceSources: Huyen, Chip. 'AI Engineering: Building Applications with Foundation Models' (O'Reilly, 2024)
